title: Fourier weight above a level
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a Boolean function, and let $k$ be a natural number with $k\le n$. The total Fourier weight of its real-valued version on subsets of size greater than $k$ equals $1-\sum_{j=0}^{k} W_j(f)$, where $W_j(f)$ is the total Fourier weight at level $j$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
